plans.name: Growth

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: For larger companies with custom needs.

footnote: All plans include a 14-day free trial. Prices are in USD.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes. Starter and Growth include a 14-day free trial. No credit card needed.

faqs.question: Can I change plans later?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade any time. Changes apply on your next billing cycle.

faqs.question: Do you offer yearly pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Yearly plans get 15% off. Contact sales for larger company pricing.

faqs.question: What is included in every plan?
faqs.answer: Every plan includes dashboards, workspaces, reports, and email or priority support based on your tier.
